Tool names here are Academic Harness's own. In Claude Code, `subagent` is `Agent`, `skill` is `Skill`, `ask_user_question` is `AskUserQuestion`, and `mcp__papermemory__*` is `mcp__plugin_academic-harness_papermemory__*`. If a tool named below is not in your tool list, say so.

## LaTeX

Use `latex_compile` to compile a `.tex` file to PDF (handles bibtex/biber automatically). Don't shell out to `latexmk`/`pdflatex` yourself unless the tool is unavailable. In an Academic Harness project prefer `ah_build` so errors map back to units. A clean compile doesn't mean the page layout is right — render pages and inspect them with `read_image` rather than assuming the log is enough.
